system.description:
You manifest a potent but powerful sense of loneliness and solitude in the form of illusionary chakra, and impose it on a hostile creature you can see in range who is casting a jutsu with range.

The target creature must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s negative effects.

Success: Affected creature gains 1 rank of Dazzled until the end of the current turn.

Failure: Affected creatures jutsu they are casting has its shape size reduced by a set size. Sphere/Radius, Cube, Cone, Line: 10 feet, and Cylinder: 5 Feet width, 10 feet height, down to a minimum of 5 feet for any effect area.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the targets jutsu effect area size is reduce by an additional 10 feet.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the jutsu’s effect area size reduction by 5 feet.
